SU_01.titleEn: TMAI - Task Management System with AI using AI Model APIs for Assignment Suggestion and Risk Calculation
SU_01.description: In small and medium-sized software development teams, project managers regularly struggle to assign tasks effectively because they have limited visibility into their team members' real-time workload, skill match and past performance. Current tools such as Jira or Trello support task tracking but offer no intelligent decision support for assignment or risk assessment, so allocation ends up being based on subjective judgement, which leads to overload, skill mismatch or project delay. Because AI services are now available through APIs from providers such as Hugging Face and OpenAI, intelligent recommendation can be integrated without building machine-learning models from scratch. TMAI is therefore designed as a decision-support tool that enhances rather than replaces human judgement, focusing on task assignment recommendation and risk prediction, and supporting multiple organisations where each organisation is a separate workspace with its own users, projects and tasks so that data stays isolated and the platform scales across teams. Its target market is small and medium software enterprises, startup teams and freelance developer teams looking for a cost-effective AI-powered alternative to enterprise tools.
SU_01.objective: The project aims to develop a web-based task management system with AI-assisted features; to integrate external AI APIs for recommendation and risk classification; to build a dashboard for monitoring task progress and risk levels; and to improve task assignment efficiency while reducing decision-making time. The system addresses two core problems specifically: task assignment recommendation, which analyses task descriptions and user profiles to suggest suitable assignees, and risk prediction, which estimates the likelihood of task delay or overload from key indicators. A commercial objective is a tiered business model comprising a free plan limited to three projects with restricted AI tokens, monthly and yearly pro plans with unlimited projects and AI features, and a yearly organisation plan offering an isolated corporate workspace with centralised management and verified member assignment.
SU_01.scope: The system serves four actors. Organisation owners create and manage organisations, manage members and assign manager roles and oversee all projects within the organisation. Administrators manage users and permissions within an organisation, configure system settings and monitor system activity. Users hold project-based roles: whoever creates a project automatically becomes its project leader, with permission to create and manage projects and tasks, assign tasks manually or through AI suggestions and monitor progress and risk levels, while all members can view assigned tasks, update task status across To-do, In Progress and Done and track personal workload, and a user may be a leader in one project and a member in another. The AI recommendation engine is treated as an external API-based system actor that supplies assignment suggestions and risk predictions to support decision-making without replacing human roles. Functional scope covers authentication and user management, project and task management with deadlines, priorities and descriptions, AI-based task assignment that evaluates suitability from skills, past performance and current workload and returns a ranked candidate list, AI risk prediction classifying tasks as low, medium or high risk from deadline proximity, task complexity, assignee workload and past delay rate, a dashboard with completion rates, risk distribution charts and performance analysis, a notification system for deadlines, high-risk alerts and assignments, and history and reporting.
SU_01.technology: ReactJS, Tailwind CSS, React Router DOM, Vite, React Native, ASP.NET Core Web API, RESTful API, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, JWT, BCrypt.Net-Next, Docker, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Hugging Face API, OpenAI API
SU_01.expectedResult: The expected outputs are a fully functional web-based task management system; AI-integrated features delivered through external APIs covering task assignment recommendation and risk prediction; a dashboard displaying task progress and risk levels; a RESTful API system; and a database storing task history and user performance. The delivered workflow runs from the organisation owner or administrator overseeing projects, through a project leader creating a task with description, deadline and required skills, to the system sending task data to the AI API, the AI returning a ranked list of suitable members, the leader selecting or overriding the suggestion, the assigned member receiving notification and updating status, the system evaluating task risk from key factors and the dashboard updating progress and risk indicators.

SU_02.titleEn: MCFH - Multichannel Customer Feedback and Sentiment Analysis Hub
SU_02.description: Businesses today receive massive amounts of customer feedback scattered across many channels including e-commerce platforms, social media, Google Maps and internal surveys. They struggle to aggregate, process and understand this unstructured data by hand, which leads to delayed responses to customer complaints and a lack of any holistic insight into service quality. The Multichannel Customer Feedback and Sentiment Analysis Hub centralises this feedback and applies natural language processing through large language model APIs to classify sentiment and extract the specific business aspects customers mention, then presents the results through an interactive dashboard that visualises satisfaction trends across channels and raises real-time alerts on severely negative reviews so that crises can be managed before they escalate.
SU_02.objective: The project aims to achieve multichannel data ingestion by building a centralised system capable of aggregating customer feedback from various sources through flexible import methods such as CSV and Excel together with structured API endpoints. It aims to provide AI-driven sentiment and aspect analysis by integrating natural language processing through LLM APIs that automatically categorise feedback as positive, negative or neutral and extract specific business aspects such as product quality and delivery speed. It further aims to deliver actionable insights and alerts through an interactive dashboard that visualises multi-channel satisfaction trends and triggers real-time alerts for highly negative reviews, enabling swift crisis management.
SU_02.scope: The system covers multichannel data collection through flexible modules that let users upload datasets via CSV or Excel alongside API endpoints designed to simulate data ingestion from external platforms such as social media or review sites; AI-powered sentiment analysis that automatically processes unstructured text using NLP to classify emotional tone as positive, negative or neutral with high accuracy; aspect and keyword extraction that automatically identifies the specific subjects customers mention such as customer service, price or shipping in order to pinpoint exact areas for improvement; a multi-channel analytics dashboard providing centralised interactive visual overviews through pie charts, line graphs and word clouds of customer satisfaction trends filtered by date, sentiment or feedback channel; a critical review alert system that flags severely negative feedback and instantly notifies managers; and historical feedback management providing a data table interface through which staff search, filter and review the entire history of processed feedback. Research scope covers multichannel architecture for standardising and aggregating diverse data formats into a unified MongoDB schema, applied AI and prompt engineering for interacting effectively with LLM APIs, and data visualisation UI/UX design principles.
SU_02.technology: React.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Chart.js, C# .NET Core Web API, MongoDB, LLM APIs (Gemini/OpenAI), NLP, Git/GitHub
SU_02.expectedResult: The expected outputs are a fully functional MVP delivering the complete omnichannel feedback hub web application with secure authentication and robust data import modules; an automated AI analysis engine implemented as a backend processing pipeline that automatically reads incoming reviews, applies sentiment labels and stores the categorised results; an interactive analytics dashboard presenting key performance metrics, sentiment ratios across channels and keyword trends; and a capstone project report containing detailed documentation of the system architecture, API specifications and an evaluation of the AI model's accuracy in processing customer feedback.

SU_03.titleEn: GigBridge (GGB) - An Intelligent AI Platform Connecting Freelancers and Businesses
SU_03.description: GigBridge is a two-sided freelance marketplace platform that connects clients, meaning the individuals or businesses that need to hire talent, with freelancers who offer their skills for hire, across all professional industries. Unlike domain-specific platforms it serves every field including IT and software, graphic design, digital marketing, content writing, translation, education and tutoring, finance and accounting, legal consulting, architecture and engineering. The platform integrates AI throughout the workflow so that clients generate professional job posts automatically, freelancers generate personalised proposals and optimise their profiles, both sides can take part in AI instant interviews for preliminary screening, and an AI work assistant supports project execution. Real-time market insights, personalised recommendations and transparent reviews build trust between both parties, while milestone-based payment, real-time chat and dispute management keep transactions safe.
SU_03.objective: The project aims to build a modern two-sided marketplace platform that seamlessly connects clients and freelancers across all industries; to integrate AI that automates key workflows including smart job post generation for clients, personalised proposal generation for freelancers and a 24/7 AI work assistant; to provide real-time market insights such as average rates by skill and industry and trending job categories together with personalised recommendations based on user behaviour and history and transparent reviews that build trust between both parties; and to deliver a responsive, multilingual Vietnamese and English web platform with robust security, secure milestone-based payment, real-time chat and dispute management optimised for both desktop and mobile users.
SU_03.scope: The platform serves four roles. Clients manage accounts and company information, view posting history and completed contracts and manage wallets and payment methods; create job postings manually or through the AI job post generator, edit, hide or close them and categorise them by field; review proposals, use smart talent matching to see AI-ranked freelancer suggestions, view public profiles, reviews and project history and conduct AI instant interviews for automated preliminary screening; chat in real time through SignalR, set and track milestones, pay by milestone through a secure gateway and raise disputes; and evaluate freelancers after project completion. Freelancers manage accounts and profiles with an AI profile optimiser suggesting additional skills, descriptions and portfolio items, view their history of received jobs and submitted proposals, browse and search jobs by industry, skill, location and salary range, receive personalised AI job suggestions, generate proposals with the AI proposal generator, participate in AI instant interviews, use the AI work assistant during execution, chat in real time, update milestone progress, receive milestone payments and evaluate clients. Administrators search, view and edit accounts, lock or unlock violating accounts, review activity history, approve, hide or delete violating job postings, manage reported proposals, moderate inappropriate reviews, resolve disputes with refund or withholding decisions and produce reports on postings, proposals, transactions, trending skills and platform revenue. Guests browse public postings, view public freelancer and client profiles, access FAQs and usage guides and view market reports before being prompted to register.
SU_03.technology: ReactJS, ASP.NET Core API, SignalR, Supabase (PostgreSQL, pgvector), RAG, LLM API, Resend, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel, Render
SU_03.expectedResult: The expected result is a responsive multilingual two-sided marketplace delivering the complete client, freelancer, administrator and guest experience with guaranteed compatibility across platforms and devices. Client-side deliverables cover account management and job posting supported by the AI job post generator, proposal management with smart talent matching, AI instant interviews for preliminary screening, real-time chat, milestone tracking, secure milestone payments and post-project evaluation. Freelancer-side deliverables cover profile creation and optimisation using the AI profile optimiser, job browsing with personalised AI recommendations, proposal creation through the AI proposal generator, participation in AI instant interviews, use of the AI work assistant during execution, real-time chat, milestone updates, payment receipt and client evaluation. Administrator deliverables cover account, posting and proposal moderation, dispute handling and statistical reporting on jobs, transactions, trending skills and revenue, while guests receive public browsing, profile viewing, FAQs and market insight reports.

SU_04.titleEn: FUOJT - Developing a Semester-Based On-the-Job Training (OJT) Management System with Data Separation and Recruitment Process Tracking at FPT University Da Nang
SU_04.description: FUOJT is a web-based internship management platform designed to bridge the gap between universities, enterprises and students in the On-the-Job Training process. At present the OJT matching process is largely manual: students search for internships independently, companies have no unified channel through which to reach qualified candidates, and university administrators struggle to track and manage hundreds of student internship applications. FUOJT solves this by providing a centralised, semester-based marketplace in which companies post opportunities, students apply and the university, through its Enterprise Relations Department and Academic Department, oversees the entire lifecycle. A defining characteristic of the platform is strict semester-based data isolation, so that each OJT cycle in Spring, Summer or Fall maintains its own separate dataset of jobs, applications and results.
SU_04.objective: The project aims to build a centralised web platform connecting students, enterprises, the Enterprise Relations Department and the Academic Department for OJT internship matching and management. It implements a semester-based data isolation model so that each OJT cycle maintains its own isolated dataset of jobs, applications and results; allows enterprises to register, create company profiles and post detailed internship positions with rich requirements, all subject to ERD approval before becoming visible to students; enables students to build professional profiles, upload multiple CVs, browse and filter postings and submit applications with full status tracking; provides the Enterprise Relations Department with full system control covering company approval, job post moderation, student management and semester lifecycle management; enables the Academic Department to verify the relevance of OJT positions to students' majors, track the OJT student list, evaluate academic reports and officially recognise final internship results; and generates statistical reports on participation, applications and placement rates per semester.
SU_04.scope: The platform is a two-sided internship marketplace governed by the university and divided across four roles. Semester management lets the ERD create, activate and close OJT semesters, with the entire platform operating within the active semester context: job postings, applications, interview schedules and results are strictly scoped to it, students see only current-semester jobs, companies manage only current-semester recruitment, the Academic Department views student lists filtered by semester and the ERD exports reports per semester. Closing a semester locks all records for that period, only the ERD can access, view and export data from previous semesters, and exactly one semester can be active at any time so that activating a new one automatically deactivates the previous. Company and employer scope covers registration with company name, industry, website, address, contact person and contact email, an ERD approval workflow granting access to the job posting module, profile management including logo upload, description, industry category, working location and contact details, profile visibility so students can research employers before applying, and ERD account suspension in case of violation. Further scope covers internship job posting and management by employers, student profile building with multiple CV uploads, application submission with status tracking, interview scheduling, Academic Department verification and result recognition, and statistical reporting.
SU_04.technology: ReactJS, ASP.NET Core Web API, PostgreSQL, JWT, OAuth2 (Google SSO), Azure Blob Storage, AWS S3, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel, Render, Azure App Service
SU_04.expectedResult: Key research areas covered are semester-based data partitioning for multi-cycle platforms, role-based access control for a four-role system, file upload and management for CV documents, real-time application status tracking with notification delivery, and statistical reporting and analytics for internship programme evaluation. The expected output is a fully functional responsive web application deployable on cloud infrastructure, supporting all user roles with their complete feature sets, an ERD reporting module with data export capability, and a well-documented RESTful API prepared for future integration with the university student portal.

SU_05.titleEn: TEDF - Building an Evaluation Framework for Detecting Duplicate Thesis Topics Based on Knowledge Domain Awareness in Software Engineering at FPT University Da Nang
SU_05.description: As the number of capstone thesis topics in Software Engineering at FPT University Da Nang continues to grow, the appraisal, evaluation and duplicate checking of thesis topics has become increasingly critical. A knowledge domain is a structured classification system describing specialised areas within software engineering such as web application development, mobile application development, artificial intelligence and machine learning, data analytics, cybersecurity, DevOps, IoT and blockchain. By building an ontology on top of this knowledge domain the system can identify the semantics of each topic, compare similarity between topics and raise alerts when topics are duplicated or overly similar. The project builds a comprehensive system that integrates thesis topic appraisal with an intelligent evaluation framework based on knowledge domain awareness, covering the whole path from topic registration through multi-party approval to final decision.
SU_05.objective: The project aims to build a comprehensive thesis topic appraisal system for FPT University Da Nang that supports the full appraisal process from topic registration to evaluation; to develop a thesis topic evaluation framework with a multi-party approval process involving mentor, evaluator and department head together with a conflict resolution mechanism; to build a topic duplicate detection mechanism based on knowledge domain awareness in software engineering that alerts on topics with similar content; and to automate topic registration, evaluator assignment and topic appraisal per semester.
SU_05.scope: The system serves five roles. Administrators manage user accounts with creation, editing and deactivation and assign role-based permissions, import the list of students eligible for capstone projects so that only listed students can log in with full student privileges, manage semesters with creation, activation and closure including automatic phase transitions, manage departments and majors and view a system overview dashboard with PDF or Excel report export and audit logs. Department heads assign two to three evaluators to each topic, make the final decision when evaluation results conflict, view the departmental topic overview and appraisal status and export reports by major, topic status and evaluation result statistics. Mentors propose topics to the topic pool, approve topics proposed by students through direct registration, edit and resubmit topics when modifications are requested, view assigned student groups and configure a semester mentor profile covering mentoring history, public information such as expertise, research areas and current group count, and private information. Students log in only if imported into the eligible list, create groups, invite members and handle join requests, view public mentor information to choose a suitable supervisor, browse and register topics from the mentor's topic pool, propose a custom topic for mentor approval and view topic status with real-time notifications. Evaluators view assigned topics, evaluate them with the three outcomes Approved, NeedsModification or Rejected and review evaluation history and resubmitted topics. Cross-role scope covers Firebase authentication, SignalR real-time notification, automated email through MailKit and knowledge-domain-based duplicate detection.
SU_05.technology: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, SignalR, ASP.NET Core 8, Entity Framework Core 8, MediatR (CQRS), SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase Authentication, Hangfire, QuestPDF, ClosedXML, MailKit, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions
SU_05.expectedResult: The research studies the knowledge domain model in software engineering in order to build an ontology for classifying thesis topics as the foundation for duplicate detection, semantic similarity detection methods applicable to topic matching including natural language processing and vector embedding techniques, Clean Architecture combined with Domain-Driven Design and the CQRS pattern for building a large-scale appraisal system with multiple roles, and the multi-level evaluation process with its conflict resolution mechanism. Expected outputs are a complete thesis topic appraisal web application supporting the five roles of admin, department head, mentor, student and evaluator, a topic evaluation framework with an automated approval workflow and evaluator assignment mechanism, a topic duplicate detection module based on semantic analysis and the IT knowledge domain, and system architecture documentation together with a user guide.

SU_06.titleEn: DTMS - Developing a Management and Support System for Establishing Waterway Tourism Tours in Da Nang City using React Native, SQL Server and .NET API
SU_06.description: The rapid growth of tourism in Da Nang City has created increasing demand for diverse and well-managed travel services, especially in waterway tourism. However, the management of boat docks and tour booking activities remains fragmented, with no centralised system to support tour operators, administrators and customers efficiently. The Developing Tour Management System addresses these challenges by providing a comprehensive platform for managing waterway tourism services: administrators manage boat docks, schedules, tours and service providers, while customers search, book and track waterway tours through a mobile-friendly interface. By integrating React Native for mobile development with .NET APIs for backend services, DTMS digitises and streamlines the entire process of waterway tourism management, enhancing operational efficiency, improving user experience and supporting sustainable tourism development in Da Nang.
SU_06.objective: The project aims to develop a centralised management system for boat docks, tour schedules and waterway tourism services; to provide a user-friendly mobile application through which customers easily search, view and book waterway tours; to support real-time data processing for tour availability, booking status and customer information management; to improve coordination and communication between administrators, tour operators and customers; to ensure secure authentication and data protection using modern technologies such as JWT and .NET APIs; to enhance system performance and scalability to accommodate future growth; and to improve the overall user experience while contributing to the sustainable development of waterway tourism in Da Nang City.
SU_06.scope: The system covers online payment through integrated gateways such as PayOS or VNPay; user information management allowing users to view, update and manage their personal information and booking history; tour search and booking enabling customers to find waterway tours by location, schedule and price and to book them; boat dock and schedule management allowing administrators to manage docks, tour schedules and availability efficiently; booking management supporting confirmation, cancellation and real-time status tracking; authentication and authorisation providing secure login and role-based access control across the administrator, operator and customer roles using JWT; a notification system delivering booking confirmations, schedule updates and important announcements; a review and rating system through which customers rate tours to improve service quality; dashboards and reporting giving administrators insight into bookings, revenue and system performance; and map integration displaying boat dock locations and routes through the Google Maps API. Business logic scope covers tour scheduling and availability checking, booking management with conflict handling and dynamic price calculation based on party size and duration.
SU_06.technology: React Native, ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET 10), RESTful API, SQL Server, JWT, PayOS, VNPay, Google Maps API, Git (GitHub/GitLab), GitHub Actions, GitLab CI
SU_06.expectedResult: The expected result is a digitised waterway tourism management platform for Da Nang delivering a mobile-friendly customer experience on top of centralised administrative control. Concretely it provides secure JWT-based login with role-based authorisation for administrators, operators and customers; tour search and booking by location, schedule and price; boat dock and schedule management with availability control; booking confirmation, cancellation and real-time status tracking; integrated online payment through PayOS or VNPay; a notification system for confirmations, schedule updates and announcements; a review and rating system; administrative dashboards and reports covering bookings, revenue and system performance; and Google Maps integration showing dock locations and routes, together with scheduling, conflict-handling and dynamic pricing logic.

SU_07.titleEn: BusDN - Develop a Real-time Bus Management and Tracking System in Da Nang City using React.js, Node.js and MongoDB
SU_07.description: In the context of urban digital transformation and smart city development, the demand for intelligent public transportation management has increased significantly. Passengers in Da Nang City currently find it difficult to access real-time information about bus routes, schedules and arrival times, while transportation operators lack an effective system for fleet management and performance monitoring. BusDN provides a unified digital platform that enables real-time tracking, management and optimisation of bus operations in the city. Passengers conveniently track bus locations and arrival times, while administrators and drivers monitor operations, manage routes and improve service reliability. The system focuses on raising operational efficiency and user experience through real-time data synchronisation, QR-based ticket validation and centralised management.
SU_07.objective: BusDN aims to provide a unified digital platform enabling real-time tracking, management and optimisation of bus operations in Da Nang City. It allows passengers to track bus locations and arrival times conveniently while enabling administrators and drivers to monitor operations, manage routes and enhance service reliability. The system additionally focuses on improving operational efficiency and user experience through real-time data synchronisation using WebSocket technology, QR-based ticket validation for fast boarding, a scalable architecture built on Node.js and MongoDB and a role-based system covering passengers, drivers, conductors and administrators.
SU_07.scope: The system serves four roles. Passengers register and log in using email or phone with OTP verification, search bus routes by bus number, station name or destination with route details, operating hours and frequency, track buses in real time on an interactive Leaflet and OpenStreetMap view with approach notifications, estimated arrival times per stop and occupancy status, save favourite routes and stops, book and pay for e-tickets using e-wallets, bank cards or QR code and receive an electronic ticket, manage tickets and transactions including active, expired and completed tickets and payment history, purchase and manage monthly passes with validity and usage history, rate routes and drivers and send feedback, and receive alerts about promotions, route changes, delays and expiring tickets. Drivers log in with company-issued credentials, view assigned routes, shift schedules and trip information, update trip status and automatically send live GPS coordinates to the server at regular intervals while receiving messages and route change notifications from the control centre. Conductors scan passenger e-ticket QR codes with the device camera, verify ticket validity, record boarding passengers and synchronise scanned data in real time. Administrators manage passenger, driver, conductor and admin accounts with role assignment, manage bus routes and stops including GPS paths, stop sequences and vehicle assignment, monitor the fleet in real time with operational status indicators, manage revenue and tickets with reports by route, day and month and peak-hour analysis, export PDF or Excel analytics, handle passenger feedback, complaints and lost-and-found cases, manage promotions, fare matrices and priority discount rules and bulk import accounts via CSV with validation and result logs.
SU_07.technology: React.js, Vite, Leaflet, Socket.IO, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas, Mongoose, Google OAuth, Firebase phone OTP, VNPAY, MoMo, GitHub, Vercel, Render
SU_07.expectedResult: The delivered system provides real-time bus tracking using WebSocket technology, QR-based ticket validation for fast boarding, a scalable Node.js and MongoDB architecture and a full role-based model covering passengers, drivers, conductors and administrators. Research and development outputs cover analysis of the requirements of all four roles and the current limitations in route information, ticketing and operational monitoring in Da Nang; research into real-time route visualisation, socket-based updates and QR code validation together with evaluation of MongoDB, Firebase phone authentication, Google OAuth and map integration; design of the client-server architecture and data models for routes, stops, schedules, tickets, monthly passes and priority profiles; implementation of the passenger web interface plus admin, driver and conductor interfaces; and testing of route data accuracy, booking flow stability, QR validation and monthly-pass processing. Identified future enhancements include AI-based ETA prediction and smart route recommendation from user travel patterns.

SU_08.titleEn: AGM - Intelligent Automotive Garage Management and Operating System
SU_08.description: As the number of automobiles grows rapidly, traditional auto repair garages face significant management pressure because manual methods such as paper records and Excel files reveal numerous limitations including data inaccuracy, inventory loss and a lack of transparency in performance-based payroll calculation. AGM was developed to digitise the entire workflow, from appointment scheduling and automatic technician assignment based on work shifts through to warranty and spare parts management. The solution not only optimises technician productivity through detailed shift handovers but also enhances the customer experience by providing maintenance forecasting and transparent pricing, meeting the inevitable digital transformation trend in the automotive service industry with a role-based system covering customers, receptionists, technicians, head technicians, inventory managers and garage owners.
SU_08.objective: The project aims to achieve operational excellence by establishing an end-to-end workflow that minimises errors from appointment booking and vehicle intake through to invoice issuance and handover; smart dispatching by automating technician assignment based on work shifts and real-time availability so that labour productivity is optimised; financial and human resource transparency by accurately recording working hours and task completion levels for precise performance-based payroll while tightly managing inventory through detailed tracking of material inflow, outflow and stock levels; an enhanced customer experience through online appointment booking, transparent pricing and an automated maintenance reminder system powered by mileage-based predictive algorithms; and decision support through analytical reporting on revenue, technician performance and service trends.
SU_08.scope: The system serves several roles across a web-based and mobile-responsive platform. Customers book appointments online selecting dates, time slots and service categories covering repair, maintenance combos or detailing, approve quotes in two phases by reviewing the initial diagnostic quote with options to approve all, decline or select specific line items and then confirming supplementary quotes when technicians discover hidden faults during disassembly, track vehicle status in real time through receiving, inspecting, awaiting parts, in-repair and completed states, look up full service history and e-warranty periods for every part and service, and participate in ratings and a loyalty programme. Receptionists and service advisors use smart vehicle reception based on licence plates with automatic text extraction to retrieve or create customer profiles, categorise the visit and record condition on a 2D visual damage map, generate quotes from catalogues or preset combos and create supplementary quotes, finalise payment with tier-based discounts, partial payments and receivables management, and handle after-sales complaints by cross-referencing old invoices to create zero-cost warranty repair orders. Technicians receive assigned vehicles and perform standardised checklist inspections, report additional faults with photographs, track actual labour with start, pause and complete controls feeding productivity-based payroll, close shifts by recording percentage completion, ongoing tasks and safety warnings, and requisition parts strictly according to customer-approved items. Head technicians perform final quality control, while inventory managers and garage owners handle stock and oversight.
SU_08.technology: ReactJS, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, WebSocket, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Render, VPS
SU_08.expectedResult: Research covers end-to-end service workflow optimisation across the digital lifecycle of vehicle servicing, intelligent resource dispatching algorithms allocating tasks by technician specialisation, shift schedule and real-time bay availability, technician productivity and performance monitoring frameworks tracking actual labour hours, task completion rates and digital shift handover protocols, and integrated inventory and spare parts logic synchronising active repair orders with warehouse stock including automated reorder-point alerts and requisition controls. Expected outputs are a cross-platform management system that is web-based and mobile-responsive with dedicated role-based interfaces for receptionists, technicians, inventory managers and garage owners; a robust and secure database system for customer profiles, vehicle service histories, spare parts catalogues and digitalised technical records; automated operation modules executing task assignment, productivity-based payroll calculation and predictive maintenance reminders; an intelligent reporting system with visual dashboards for revenue, material costs and employee performance rankings; and a complete business documentation set including UML system architecture, database ERDs and standard operating procedures for a digital garage environment.

SU_09.titleEn: SafeRide (SRD) - Develop a Real-time Personal Driver Booking and Management System
SU_09.description: With rapid urbanisation and the growth of on-demand services, the need for safe and flexible personal driver solutions is increasing. Although some services already exist, they are not widely adopted in Da Nang or other regions, and there is still no well-established platform connecting users with professional drivers who operate the customer's own vehicle. Many people encounter situations in which they cannot drive themselves, for example after drinking, on long trips or because of health issues, which creates inconvenience and potential safety risks. SafeRide is a real-time platform connecting customers with freelance drivers, enabling flexible hourly or per-trip booking, ensuring transparency and safety through driver verification and trip monitoring, and supporting administrators in managing operations efficiently. Its target users are vehicle owners who cannot or prefer not to drive, freelance drivers offering personal driving services and system administrators.
SU_09.objective: The project proposes SafeRide as a real-time platform that connects customers with freelance drivers, enables flexible booking by hour or by trip, ensures transparency and safety and supports administrators in managing operations efficiently. Concretely it aims to research GPS tracking, real-time communication, driver-customer matching algorithms and secure payment integration; to emphasise safety through driver KYC verification and trip monitoring; to design a client-server system architecture, develop mobile applications for customers and drivers together with an admin dashboard; and to evaluate the resulting system for performance, scalability and user experience.
SU_09.scope: The system will be developed and tested within a limited scope in Da Nang city, focusing on core functionality covering driver booking, real-time tracking and basic payment integration. Customer scope covers registration and login by email or phone with OTP verification and profile management, driver booking by hour or per trip with pick-up and destination selection on Google Maps, fare estimation before confirmation and advance scheduling, driver information and selection based on ratings, experience and nearby availability, real-time trip tracking with driver location, ETA and progress notifications, sandbox payment through VNPay or PayOS with transaction history, trip history management with cancellation and rebooking, ratings and feedback, notifications and alerts, and safety features including trip sharing with friends or family and an SOS emergency button that sends alerts with real-time location. Driver scope covers login with an approved driver account, profile and availability management with online and offline status, and booking handling. Administrator scope covers system monitoring and management through a web dashboard.
SU_09.technology: ReactJS, Flutter (Dart), ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, SignalR, Google Maps API, Cloudinary, VNPay, PayOS, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel, SmarterASP.NET, Render
SU_09.expectedResult: The expected output is a complete SafeRide system comprising a mobile application for customers, a mobile application for drivers, a web-based admin dashboard, a backend API system covering booking, users, drivers and payment, a real-time trip tracking and driver matching system, a secure payment and transaction management module, a reports and analytics dashboard, full documentation covering architecture, implementation, testing and the user guide, and a demonstration with simulated or real data. The payment module is delivered as an integrated online payment flow using a sandbox gateway such as VNPay or PayOS. Testing validates booking workflows, real-time tracking accuracy and system responsiveness, evaluates usability, reliability and scalability under multiple users and verifies safety features including SOS alerts and trip sharing.

SU_10.titleEn: PulmoCare (PDCMS) - Pulmonary Disease Care and Monitoring System
SU_10.description: Chronic pulmonary diseases such as COPD, asthma and lung infections are among the leading causes of morbidity in Vietnam and place a significant burden on both patients and healthcare facilities. Managing these conditions requires continuous coordination between clinicians, patients and caregivers, a process that is currently fragmented, paper-based or dependent on disconnected tools. Diagnosis of pulmonary disease through chest X-ray imaging depends entirely on physician expertise with no AI-assisted support, which increases the risk of missed diagnoses particularly at lower-level facilities where specialists are scarce. PulmoCare closes these gaps with an integrated digital healthcare ecosystem consisting of a web application for doctors and nurses supporting AI-assisted pulmonary diagnosis from X-ray images combined with clinical symptoms, patient record management, prescription management and appointment scheduling, and a mobile application for patients enabling appointment booking, prescription photo upload with automatic medication schedule generation through OCR, push notification reminders and AI health consultation via chatbot.
SU_10.objective: The project aims to build an AI module for pulmonary disease diagnosis in which doctors upload chest X-ray images and input clinical symptom descriptions and the system automatically analyses and classifies pathologies such as pneumonia, tuberculosis, COPD, pleural effusion, pulmonary fibrosis, lung tumour and normal findings together with confidence scores and lesion heatmaps. It aims to develop a web application for doctors and nurses managing patient records, medical history, prescriptions based on the Ministry of Health drug catalogue, appointment scheduling and treatment monitoring, with nurses assisting doctors in arranging appointments, updating vital signs and tracking patient care. It further aims to ensure regulatory compliance through medical data security, role-based access control and immutable audit logging of all operations on patient records, and to build synchronised technical infrastructure covering push notifications, offline mode with data synchronisation and automated backup and recovery.
SU_10.scope: The system spans a web application for clinical staff and a mobile application for patients across four roles. Authentication and access management provides secure login for administrators, doctors, nurses and patients with mandatory two-factor authentication by OTP for clinical staff, biometric or PIN login on mobile and automatic session timeout. AI-powered pulmonary diagnosis analyses X-ray images together with clinical symptoms. Patient record management covers registration with personal information, medical history, allergies, chronic conditions and health insurance numbers, full-text search by name, patient code or phone number and a chronological medical history timeline with date and condition filters. The nurse dashboard shows assigned patients and care status, coordinates appointment schedules for doctors, updates vital signs and daily care notes and receives notifications for new registrations or cases requiring attention. Appointment scheduling and reminders let patients book by doctor, specialty and time slot with push confirmations, reminders twenty-four hours and one hour beforehand and cancellation or rescheduling with automatic clinic notification. Further scope covers prescription OCR with medication scheduling, an AI health chatbot built on RAG over Ministry of Health guidelines with a clear disclaimer that it does not replace medical consultation, system-wide role-based access control, offline mode with local caching and background synchronisation, immutable audit logging of patient record access and automated backup and recovery.
SU_10.technology: ReactJS, React Native, Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Deep Learning, Tesseract OCR, Google Cloud Vision API, LangChain, RAG, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Ubuntu Server (VPS), Nginx
SU_10.expectedResult: The research investigates deep learning model architectures for pulmonary pathology classification from chest X-ray images, multimodal fusion techniques that combine X-ray image data with clinical symptom data to improve diagnostic accuracy, OCR techniques for recognising Vietnamese medical prescriptions and automatically extracting drug name, dosage and frequency, RAG-based AI chatbot architecture integrated with a knowledge base drawn from Vietnamese Ministry of Health treatment guidelines, and multi-platform architecture covering secure authentication with 2FA and OTP, the RBAC model, push notifications, offline-first mobile design and data synchronisation. The project delivers PulmoCare Web for doctors and nurses as a clinic management application with integrated AI chest X-ray diagnosis, PulmoCare Mobile for patients on iOS and Android supporting appointment booking, prescription OCR, medication reminders and the AI health chatbot, together with source code, API documentation, a deployment guide and a test report.

SU_11.titleEn: SECOM - Building an E-Commerce Website for Second-Hand Products with Price Prediction AI using ReactJS, SQL Server and .NET
SU_11.description: The second-hand product market is growing rapidly, but price estimation remains a challenge for users on both sides of a transaction: sellers do not know what their item is realistically worth and buyers cannot judge whether a listed price is fair. This project develops an e-commerce platform on which users post, browse and purchase used items, and applies AI to predict reasonable prices based on product category, condition and market data so that both sellers and buyers can make better decisions. The system additionally uses AI to detect duplicate or fraudulent listings, and is built with ReactJS on the front end, ASP.NET Core on the back end and SQL Server for data storage, with administrative tooling for monitoring, reporting and system management.
SU_11.objective: The project aims to build an e-commerce website for trading second-hand products; to allow users to create listings, upload images and manage their products; to enable buyers to search, filter and purchase items; to integrate AI services that predict fair prices based on product features and detect duplicate or fraudulent listings; and to provide administrative tools for monitoring, reporting and system management. The AI plan is to build a machine learning model that estimates product prices from historical data and to use APIs or deployed models for real-time price suggestion while an item is being posted.
SU_11.scope: The system covers user registration and authentication; product listing with images and descriptions; automatic AI price prediction presented while a product is being posted; product browsing with advanced search and filters; order and payment management; an admin panel for content and user control; real-time statistics and dynamic report generation for administrators; and fraud detection and reporting mechanisms. Development scope covers analysis of user requirements and system design, implementation of product listings, search and filters, user accounts and the order system, integration of the AI model for price estimation, and construction of the admin dashboard for user and content management.
SU_11.technology: ReactJS, .NET (ASP.NET Core), SQL Server, scikit-learn, XGBoost, OpenAI API, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps
SU_11.expectedResult: The expected output products are an e-commerce web application for second-hand goods, complete system documentation covering design, requirements and testing, and an AI pricing demo module. The delivered platform provides user registration and authentication, product listing with image upload and description, automatic AI-based price prediction during posting, product browsing with advanced search and filtering, order and payment management, an administrative panel for content and user control with real-time statistics and dynamic report generation, and fraud detection with reporting mechanisms.

SU_12.titleEn: TMPMS - Building a Management System for Traditional Medicine Pharmacies in Da Nang using .NET, SQL Server and ReactJS
SU_12.description: In Da Nang, traditional medicine pharmacies operate independently, which makes it difficult for customers to find a suitable pharmacy on the basis of distance, price or service quality. There is currently no centralised system allowing users to compare and choose the most appropriate pharmacy, so most customers rely on personal experience or offline recommendations. This project builds a centralised platform that connects multiple traditional medicine pharmacies, allowing users to search, compare and select the nearest and most suitable pharmacy efficiently, with map-based location services calculating distance from the user, per-pharmacy medicine catalogues and inventory, online ordering and a rating system that helps subsequent customers choose better.
SU_12.objective: The project aims to build a centralised platform that connects multiple traditional medicine pharmacies in Da Nang so that users can search, compare and select the nearest and most suitable pharmacy efficiently. Supporting objectives are to analyse the business model of multi-pharmacy systems, to study location-based services covering distance calculation and map integration, to identify and implement the system roles of user, supplier or pharmacy owner and administrator, to design the system architecture and database, and to develop a web-based platform with real-time search and filtering.
SU_12.scope: The system covers user authentication with registration, login and role-based access; pharmacy search as the core feature, finding the nearest pharmacies based on user location, displaying them on a map and sorting by distance, rating or price; pharmacy management for suppliers, in which pharmacy owners register accounts subject to administrator approval and manage pharmacy information covering address, contact details and services; a medicine catalogue in which each pharmacy manages its own medicines and users browse medicines by pharmacy; online ordering allowing users to place orders with a selected pharmacy and track order status; a rating and review system through which users rate pharmacies and help others choose; inventory management of stock for each pharmacy; an admin dashboard for managing users and pharmacies, approving pharmacy registrations and monitoring system activity; map integration showing pharmacy locations and calculating distance from the user; and an optional blog and consultation area for sharing traditional medicine knowledge.
SU_12.technology: ReactJS, ASP.NET Core Web API, RESTful API, SQL Server, MongoDB, JWT, Google Maps API, Git, Visual Studio
SU_12.expectedResult: The expected result is a centralised web platform connecting the independent traditional medicine pharmacies of Da Nang under one searchable directory. It delivers location-based pharmacy search with map display and sorting by distance, rating or price using the Google Maps API for distance calculation; supplier onboarding in which pharmacy owners register subject to administrator approval and then manage their pharmacy profile, medicine catalogue and inventory; an online ordering flow with order status tracking; a rating and review system supporting better customer choice; an administrative dashboard covering user and pharmacy management, registration approval and activity monitoring; and an optional blog and consultation section sharing traditional medicine knowledge.

SU_13.titleEn: PORMS - Develop a Decision Support and Risk Warning System for Seaport Operations Based on Real-time Weather Data
SU_13.description: In coastal countries such as Vietnam, port operations play a critical role in logistics and supply chain systems, yet port activity is highly affected by environmental factors, especially strong winds, heavy rain, storms and pressure changes. In many real-world scenarios operational decisions such as stopping vessel entry, reducing loading activity or shutting down equipment are made on the basis of human experience and fragmented data sources, which produces inconsistent decision-making, delayed response to rapidly changing weather and increased operational risk. PORMS bridges the gap between environmental data and real-world port operations by introducing a structured Weather to Risk to Decision to Action pipeline: it collects real-time weather data through external APIs, evaluates operational risk against standardised thresholds such as the Beaufort scale, transforms risk levels into operational decisions and automatically triggers standard operating procedures. The system is designed with reference to real operational scenarios at a Vietnamese logistics and port operation company.
SU_13.objective: The project aims to develop a system that collects real-time weather data via external APIs, evaluates operational risks against standardised thresholds such as the Beaufort scale, transforms risk levels into operational decisions and automatically triggers standard operating procedures. Beyond the core operational backend it aims to develop a lightweight data warehouse supporting historical analysis and decision-making, using an orchestration tool to build, deploy, run and monitor data pipelines that keep data available in near real time while maintaining system simplicity and stability, and to deliver interactive dashboards embedded directly into the web portal so that managers and operators can access insights into risk trends over time, the relationship between weather conditions and operational risk and operational performance indicators within the same interface.
SU_13.scope: The system covers twelve functional areas. User management and authentication provides JWT-based authentication with role-based access control for administrators and operators in a single-tenant deployment. Port and zone management maintains basic port information and defines operational zones covering dock, yard and gate. Weather data processing integrates the OpenWeather API, collects and stores wind speed, rainfall and related parameters and maintains historical records. The risk engine evaluates operational risk from wind speed using the Beaufort scale and weather conditions and classifies risk as LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL through configurable rule-based logic. The SOP decision engine maps risk levels to operational decisions such as limiting operations at HIGH and stopping operations at CRITICAL based on real-world port safety guidelines. The operation action log automatically generates entries when risk conditions occur, recording system decisions rather than assigning tasks to users, and stores them for traceability. Operation mode management automatically determines whether the port is in NORMAL, LIMITED or STOP mode. Zone-based operational recommendation provides zone-specific guidance displayed through the dashboard and alerts without physical enforcement. Further scope covers an alert and notification system, operation logging of weather updates, risk evaluations and triggered actions, a data warehouse with an ETL pipeline and Metabase dashboards embedded into the portal, and system evaluation and simulation validating decision rules against real-world guidelines.
SU_13.technology: React.js, ASP.NET Core, Python (ETL), PostgreSQL, Prefect, Metabase, OpenWeather API, Docker, GitHub, GitHub Actions, AWS, Vercel
SU_13.expectedResult: The expected output is a system capable of real-time weather monitoring, risk assessment, decision support and operational workflow automation, together with a dashboard portal for monitoring port conditions, viewing alerts and operational status and analysing historical trends. Research deliverables cover weather data integration collecting wind speed, rainfall and temperature; a risk evaluation model applying Beaufort-scale thresholds and port safety guidelines through rule-based classification from LOW to CRITICAL; SOP modelling that converts real-world port operation guidelines into system rules mapping risk levels to actions; backend design with multi-tenant architecture and RESTful APIs; operational workflow automation triggering tasks and managing operation states and logs; system evaluation validating decision logic against real-world guidelines and simulating historical weather data; and data warehouse and BI integration.
